overview_description.description: Unravel Carbon provides a platform for enterprises to measure, reduce, and report on their carbon emissions, promoting a zero carbon economy. The company focuses on integrating climate-driven decisions into business practices to ensure sustainability for future generations. Unravel Carbon combines technology and expert support to guide organizations in their sustainability journey.

about_short_description.short_description: Unravel Carbon is a enterprise software for companies to track and reduce their carbon emissions.

product.name: Unravel Carbon Platform
product.description: An enterprise software platform for measuring, managing, and reporting carbon emissions across organizations.

product.name: AI-Assisted ISSB Reporting Solution
product.description: A software tool that guides companies through ISSB climate risk reporting with AI-powered workflows and collaboration features.

product.name: Integrated ESG Solution
product.description: A platform that consolidates ESG data and workflows to streamline multi-framework ESG disclosures and compliance reporting.

product.name: Product Carbon Footprint Solution (PCF)
product.description: A customizable solution for tracking and analyzing product-level carbon emissions across various product types and lifecycle stages.
